description_en: Queries the regions that support Express Connect Router (ECR)
description_zh: 查询专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）开服地域列表
name: ListExpressConnectRouterSupportedRegion

parameters.help_en:
The type of network instance. Valid values:

TR: transit router instance.

VBR: virtual border router instance.

VPC: virtual private cloud instance
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例的类型。取值：
TR：转发路由器实例。
VBR：边界路由器实例。
VPC：虚拟专有网络实例
parameters.name: node_type

parameters.help_en:
A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a value that is unique across different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId as the ClientToken. Each request has a unique RequestId
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 200 indicates that the call was successful. For more information about other values, see the error codes
Code.description_zh: 判断调用是否成功。返回值为200表示加载成功，返回其他值表示加载失败，失败原因参见错误码

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

True: The call was successful.

False: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：
True：成功。
False：失败
